title: USB 3.x SuperSpeed pair (SSTX or SSRX) of a TI AM57xx or DRA7xx processor

spraar7j.title: High-Speed Interface Layout Guidelines, application note

impedance.where: Table A-2 (AM57xx/DRA7xx), row 'SuperSpeed SSRX or SSTX pair differential impedance', page 16

length.where: Table A-2, row 'USB3.0 (SuperSpeed) Tracelength (Total)', 3500 mil maximum, page 16

skew.where: Table A-2, row 'Skew within any USB3/SATA/PCIe/HDMI differential pair', 5 mil maximum, page 16

vias.where: Table A-2, row 'Number of vias allowed on any USB3 differential trace (Total)', 2 maximum, page 16

stubs.where: Table A-2, row 'Number of stubs allowed on any differential pair trace (Total)', 0 maximum, page 16; sections 3.5 (page 10) and 3.6 (page 11) name a through pin and a via's barrel past the signal's layer as stubs
stubs.not_judged: the stubs, 0 allowed, are not judged: the command does not trace a branch, a test point, or the barrel of a via or a through pin past the layer the signal leaves on

plane.where: section 2.4 'High-Speed Signal Reference Planes', page 6: over a solid reference plane, not across a split or a void

stitching.unit: mm from a via that changes the ground reference to a ground via, center to center
stitching.where: section 2.4, page 8: 'maintain the same GND reference from origination to termination'; if not, GND stitching vias 'within 200 mils (center-to-center ...) of the signal transition vias'

coupling.where: section 3.3 'Symmetry in the Differential Pairs', page 10: the pair routed together, symmetric and parallel; deviations at package escape and connector pins as short as possible, 'package break-out must occur within 0.25 inches of the package'

spacing.unit: mm, edge to edge, to a track of any other signal on the layer
spacing.where: Table A-2, row 'Differential pair to any other signal trace spacing', 30 mil minimum, page 16; section 3.1, page 9

clock_spacing.unit: mm, edge to edge, to a clock or periodic signal
clock_spacing.where: Table A-2, row 'Differential pair to clock or high-speed periodic signal trace spacing', 50 mil minimum, page 16; section 3.1, page 9
clock_spacing.not_judged: the 50 mil (1.27 mm) to a clock or periodic signal is not judged: the board does not say which nets carry a clock (the 30 mil to any other signal is judged)

test_points.where: Table A-2, row 'Number of test points permitted on any differential pair trace (Total)', 0 maximum, page 16; section 3.2, page 9
test_points.not_judged: the test points, 0 allowed, are not judged: the command does not tell a test point from another pad, via or footprint on the net

plane_edge.unit: mm from the edge of the reference plane
plane_edge.where: section 3.2 'High-Speed Differential Signal Rules', page 9: 'routed >= 90 mils from the edge of the reference plane'
plane_edge.not_judged: the 90 mil (2.286 mm) from the plane's edge is not judged: KiCad writes a fill as 1 outline whose holes join it by slits, and the command does not tell the plane's edge from a void in it

voids.unit: trace widths from a void in the reference plane
voids.where: section 3.2 'High-Speed Differential Signal Rules', page 9: 'at least 1.5 W (calculated trace-width x 1.5) away from voids in the reference plane', except where SMD pads of the pair are voided
voids.not_judged: the 1.5 W from voids is not judged: the command does not tell a void from the plane's edge in KiCad's fill outline, nor the pair's own voided pads from another void
